Futhi, ngokuchofoza "Thuthukisa", ukubhaliswa kwakho kuzokwenziwa ngokuzenzakalela ngesenzo esifanayo ngamanani afanayo kuze kube usukukhansela kusuka kuzilungiselelo ku-Google Play Store.

Isivivinyo sakho samahhala sizoguqulwa ngokuzenzakalela sibe ukubhaliswa konyaka uma sesiqedile. Futhi, ngokuchofoza "Izinsuku Zokubhaliswa", iphakheji yakho izokwenziwa ngokuzenzakalela ngamanani afanayo kuze kube usukukhansela kusuka kuzilungiselelo ku-Google Play Store.

Ngokuchofoza "Qhubeka", ukukhokha kwakho kuzokhokhwa ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google Play futhi ukubhaliswa kwakho kuzokwenziwa ngokuzenzakalela ngesenzo esifanayo ngamanani afanayo kuze kube usukukhansela kusuka kuzilungiselelo ku-Google Play Store.
Zama inguqulo yokukhokhelwa bese ususa izikhangiso
Ukubhaliswa okuqhubekayo, kukhanselwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
Izindikimba eziningi zokukhokhelwayo ukuze ushintshe uhlelo lwakho.
Nciphisa ukucindezeleka kwamehlo ngokusebenzisa izindikimba ze-gradient noma izindikimba ezimnyama.
Sula kalula amafayela ongawadingi, njengezithombe noma amavidiyo.
Gcina isikhala sokugcina sikahle futhi singanqamuki.
Vimbela amafayela asusiwe ngokungafanele ngokuhlinzeka ngengxenye yokuphepha.
Jabulela izici eziphambili ngaphandle kwezikhangiso eziphazamisayo.
Sheshisa isikhathi sokulayisha amakhasi futhi uthuthukise ukusebenza jikelele.
Nciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwedatha futhi mhlawumbe ugcine idatha yakho ephathekayo.
Lungisa usayizi nobubanzi be-izithombe noma amavidiyo.
Thuthukisa ukubekwa komfanekiso bese ususa izinto ezingafuneki kusuka esithombeni noma ividiyo.
Gcina isikhala sokugcina ngokunciphisa usayizi wefayela lezithombe noma amavidiyo amakhulu.
Kulula ukuhamba ngezwi lezinkondlo zomculo wakho owuthandayo.
Thuthukisa ulwazi lwakho lomculo ku-inthanethi nakwi-offline.
Ukusetshenziswa okungapheli ngokuphila ukuze uvikele idivayisi yakho ezinkopini eziphindaphindayo
Kusiza ukonga isikhathi, nokugwema ukudideka ngokuhlonza & ukususa izinkopi eziphindaphindayo zamafayela
Kwehlisa isikhala sokugcina esidingekayo ngokususa izinkopi ezingafuneki zamafayela.
Inguqulo yokukhokhelwa ikunika izinzuzo zokuhlola nokujabulela ukufinyelela kwangaphambi kwezici ezikhethekile ezizayo.
